messages:
kai.new: Hi all, just joined and trying to sort Vault/KMS access for my service (staging -> prod later). What's the canonical onboarding flow and who signs off for prod?

rachel.devex: Welcome Kai! :wave: Short flow: 1) Open a secret_request in #platform-requests with the template. 2) Infra provisions staging after approval. 3) Prod needs a business approver + security approver.

omar.security: For prod I or my delegate must be listed as security approver. Key rules: no wildcard paths, per-env Vault paths, and prefer dynamic DB creds. Static secrets rotate every 90 days by default.

kai.new: Can I get the ticket template to paste? Also how do GH Actions authenticate to Vault?

rachel.devex: Paste this into the ticket body (replace placeholders):

secret_request:
  requester: kai.new
  service: model-scorer
  envs: [staging, prod]
  vault_paths:
    - secret/data/model-scorer/staging: read
    - secret/data/model-scorer/prod: read
  kms_key: projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/models/cryptoKeys/model-cmk
  use_dynamic_db: true
  approver: @omar.security
  reason: runtime DB creds + CI integration tests

rachel.devex: GH Actions: use OIDC to mint short-lived Vault tokens (we have examples in infra-shared/actions/vault-login). Avoid storing long-lived secrets in GitHub.

omar.security: For rotation: dynamic DB creds use TTLs (automated). If you must use static secrets, set rotation cadence and owner in the ticket. Emergency rotation: open an incident and tag @security.

infra-bot: Ticket PR-3347 created (secret_request). ETA staging: 1 business day, prod: 3 business days for approvals.

vault-bot: policy "svc-model-scorer-staging" created and mounted at secret/data/model-scorer/staging (audit: f12b).

kai.new: Awesome, thanks. If I see permission denied after policy attach who should I ping?

rachel.devex: Ping me or @infra-ops with the exact client error and the principal. We'll check policy+identity mapping. Happy to do a 15-min walkthrough if you want. :thumbsup:
